capabilities: sync a vault through GitHub, Dropbox, or Google Drive
merge notes changed on two devices or keep both versions
exclude folders, file types, and settings from syncing
sync automatically on startup and at an interval
keep earlier note versions as GitHub commit history
extras: Freemium: GitHub sync is free; Dropbox and Google Drive are free for 3 months, then need a license key sold through Dodo Payments ($3/month, $24/year, or $49 once). Full documentation lives on an external docs site; syncing the installed plugin list runs plugin code from other devices.
problem: Syncing an Obsidian vault across phones and computers usually needs Git installed or a paid sync service, and large first downloads on phones often fail.

relations.evidence: Already syncing with Git? Use Git or Sync Evo on a device, not both.

requires.name: license key for Dropbox and Google Drive after 3 months

summary: Vault syncer that keeps notes in sync across devices through your own GitHub repository, Dropbox or Google Drive folder, with no Git on the device.
